caption: The drawing depicts two objects on a plain, off-white background bordered by a double-line rectangular frame. The upper object is an oval, gold-colored lid rendered in a side view, showing its thickness and slight shading around the edges to indicate dimension. Below the lid, centrally placed, is a circular, gold-colored container lid or box top viewed from above. The center of the circular lid features a rectangular inscription panel with an ornate border. Within the panel, there is text in a combination of script and decorative styles. The visible text on the circular lid reads: "Tobacco good within this box / If you stand and pay the pox / If you put it in your nose / Let lawyers clargy and those / John Winslow / 1747", with some decorative scrollwork separating the text lines. The composition is minimal, with the two objects evenly spaced on the page, and the color palette consists mainly of gold and brown tones for the objects, with black or dark gray lines and lettering for the images and text.
title: Snuff Box
